Join Evoke’s Data Engineering Team 
 At Evoke, data is at the heart of how we build, innovate, and make decisions. Our Data
Technologies Group plays a central role across the organization, making data accessible,
reliable, and actionable for stakeholders across the business.
We’re currently undergoing an exciting technology transformation—moving from legacy on-
premise systems to a modern, cloud-native data platform powered by technologies such as
AWS, Snowflake, Airflow, and dbt.
As a Data Engineer on our Cross Development Team, you’ll be part of this transformation,
designing and developing robust backend data solutions that integrate a wide range of data
sources. You’ll own solutions from development through production, with a strong focus on
 data quality, scalability, reliability, and performance .
This is an opportunity to work at the core of Evoke’s data ecosystem, tackle meaningful
engineering challenges, and help shape the future of our data platform.
 Be part of Data engineers team working in Agile methodology.
 Develop complex Data Pipelines using Microsoft ETL technologies (SSIS).
 Develop new Data Processes using Apache Airflow, DBT & Snowflake.
 Working with high scale databases and providing Back-End Data solution from design
 phase, through development and up to implementation.
 Working with various stakeholders and applications across the company.
 What You'll Be Doing
 As a Data Engineer you will be responsible for:
 Designing and developing complex ETL processes and data driven solutions.
 Working with high scale databases and providing Backend BI solution from design
 phase, through development and up to implementation.
 Working with various stakeholders and applications across the company.
 Who We're Looking For
 At least 3 years of experience with large-scale DWH environments.
 At least 3 years of experience in design and development of ETL processes in SQL Server
 Integration Services (SSIS).
 Strong background in writing SQL queries and procedures.
 High English language skills.
 Advantage If You Have
 Experience in DBT / Apache Airflow.
 Experience in Snowflake.
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science / IS Engineering / Related field.
 Experience working in Agile methodology.
 Highly motivated and independent.
 What We Offer
 Our roles offer more than just a job, you’ll become part of the evoke family! We have created an
environment where our people can thrive. Check out some of the fantastic benefits on offer:
 Financial: Competitive salary
 Hybrid working: Our employees can work from home up to 80% of the time with 20% of
 office time built in to ensure we get some face-to-face collaborative team time - and the
chance for a coffee and a catch-up!
 Holiday entitlement: You’ll be entitled to 22 annual leave days, plus bank holidays and
 an extra day for your birthday.
 eLearning 
 Family Support: Industry-leading maternity and paternity leave and paid time off if you
 have caring responsibilities.
 Health & wellbeing: Tools and services to help support your well-being, including
 support with mental health and financial education. You will also have access to gym
discounts.
 Healthcare: We prioritize your health and well-being, offering comprehensive
 healthcare benefits.
 More About Evoke
 We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands
William Hill, 888 and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new sense
of purpose, direction and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more exciting time to
join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our customers with world-
class betting and gaming experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke.
At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space to be
yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your
future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you.
